fields.postcondition: no rendering work is done when Debug logging is disabled
fields.response: check logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug) and, only when Debug is enabled, render the compiled expression tree as a debug-view string and log it at Debug under event id ExpressionTreeCreation, through that method's own delegate and event name — so CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderOrdinals emits a CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderOrdinals event with its ordinals message, distinct from CreatedExpressionTreeForReaderRowData
fields.subject: Core Log Events
fields.trigger: code elsewhere in the library calls one of the six CreatedExpressionTreeFor* wrapper methods (SetInParameters, SetOutParameters, ReadOutParameters, ReaderOrdinals, ReaderRowData, or Model) with a newly compiled expression tree for a model type
